The first 15,360-byte host bulk URB completed successfully and in full after
774 microseconds. On the Pi, the matching single 15,360-byte FunctionFS read
never returned. The preserved ep1 OUT request remained in progress with zero
bytes recorded as completed, even after physical USB detach.

Unlike Gate B, Gate C is not explained by a partial or cancelled host URB.
The transfer was exactly 30 high-speed 512-byte packets and therefore ended
without a short final packet.
